meta.title: Project Lighthouse — Executive Brief
meta.subtitle: One-page status for the July steering meeting

blocks.text: Migration of the reporting stack to the unified data platform. **Phase 2 of 3.** Overall status: on track with one watched risk.

items: Ingestion cutover finished for 14 of 16 source systems.
Latency on the exec dashboard cut from 9s to 2.1s.
Legacy report deprecation notice sent; 3 teams flagged dependencies.

blocks.title: Vendor SSO dependency
blocks.text: Identity vendor's SAML patch slips to **August 22**. Mitigation in place: scoped service accounts for the two affected systems until the patch lands.

items: Confirm the September 12 gate date with the two dependency-flagged teams.
Approve carrying the SSO mitigation as an accepted risk through August.
